scope: Scratch-only ASCII staged graph scanner for the selected AC1018 MLINE output profile. Inputs were locally generated controls; no generated DXF was added to the repository.

budgetPolicy.disposition: Exceeding any scanner budget refuses the selected verified save. The writer's atomic transaction must preserve the prior destination; no unverified fallback is published.
budgetPolicy.consumerRisk: The limits are safety bounds, not observed LibreCAD document maxima. A valid unusually large drawing may be refused on the selected MLINE verified-save route. Keep them private and fail closed until representative consumer coverage supports different values.
budgetPolicy.testability: The scratch scanner now accepts a private StageReadBudget with production defaults. Boundary tests lower individual limits to the measured input size, avoiding multi-megabyte or 256 MiB allocations. Do not expose this test control as public libdxfrw API.

boundaryControls.result: 34 focused controls pass: measured limits accept exactly at the boundary and refuse one below; a generated unrelated dictionary entry exercises per-record, total-entry and aggregate-key one-over refusal; an unrelated dictionary with two reactors refuses at a cap of one and passes at two; expected-count caps and invalid zero/oversized limits refuse.

defaultCapControls.result: The unchanged production defaults refuse generated controls with a 256-byte dictionary key, 100001 dictionary entries, aggregate key names exceeding 4 MiB, and a line exceeding 1 MiB.
defaultCapControls.largeFileLimit: The 256 MiB staged-file cap was exercised with an injected lower test budget at the exact measured source size and one byte below; allocating a 256 MiB drawing solely to hit the production threshold was skipped.

atomicRefusalRetry.testHook: Injects a 1 MiB-plus ASCII value line into the staged temporary output after encoding and before graph verification.
atomicRefusalRetry.result: ASCII, Binary and style-handle-collision inputs all reject the over-budget stage, retain the seeded destination sentinel byte-for-byte, and succeed on corrected retry using the same filter instance.

semanticScannerControls.result: The unchanged selected graph passes; fifteen malformed graph, type, handle-role and field mutations refuse.
semanticScannerControls.testLimits: Generated low-cost controls use at most 4.4 MiB; no committed or external test fixture is used.

limitations: This is scratch evidence for the bounded bundled prototype, not an installed LibreCAD consumer result.
The atomic over-budget hook exercises the line-length refusal path; the 256 MiB file-byte threshold was boundary-tested by lowering the private test budget, not by creating a 256 MiB file.
The full bounded installed-filter inspector still needs a focused reviewable consumer patch and one application build. Native GUI and large-document compatibility qualification remain open.
next: Carry only the bounded MLINE staged inspectors and their required MLINE source-model guards into a focused LibreCAD patch; build the isolated app and relevant fast selector, then update P8-D evidence.
